provenance.supersedes_note: Prior artifacts using Gaussian storage noise with hard 2.5σ tubes (joint misspecification) and OD LPs without declared path caps are superseded. Baseline contract: uniform_bounded noise with shared obs_tolerance; Gaussian and boundary/count stresses are named variants only.
provenance.embargo_note: Real TrafficFlowBench February-week adapters need an explicit embargo and freshness evidence before treating holdout windows as final; this pilot uses only synthetic truth.

config.description: Amended synthetic final evaluation (v4). Independent RNG seeds from final_holdout_v4_seed_manifest.json; chain layout n_links=7 (disjoint from dev n_links=5). Stress families match archived v3 declaration. Not a real-world generalization claim.
